title: finding(types): the objectui#8774 doc reader locates the `;` before stripping comments — a `;` inside a union-row comment truncates it to 8 members and reports "mirror widened", a false diagnosis
body:
The round-1 contract review of PR objectui#9069 (record `5626314039`, ceiling tier, transcript-verified 61/61) returned **PASS** with three owed non-blocking corrections. They are filed here rather than ridden in: the charter gives the dispatching seat two moves on a subagent verdict — adopt verbatim or void entirely — and a repair round would have moved the head and voided a PASS to fix a docblock sentence and a parser edge case.

⛔ Not graded, no `domain:*` — triage's.

## ⭐ Item 1 is the one that matters: `docUnionMembers` strips comments AFTER locating the `;`

`packages/types/src/__tests__/filter-builder-mirror-6939.test.ts` — the reader added by PR objectui#9069 finds the statement terminator **first** and only then removes comments. So a `;` appearing **inside a comment on a union row** truncates the parse.

Measured by the reviewer: the member list comes back at **8** instead of 14, and the pin then fails with **`mirror widened past the authority`** — a diagnosis that is **false**. The mirror did not widen; the reader under-read the doc.

⚠️ It fails **loud and in the safe direction**, which is why this is not blocking. But a wrong diagnosis on a gate whose whole purpose is to be believed is worth more than a wrong pass: the next reader is told the mirror is at fault when the reader is.

**Fix:** strip comments **before** locating the terminator. ⚠️ Re-derive the current order yourself — ⛔ do not take this description on trust — and add a firing control that plants a `;` inside a union-row comment, proving the reader still returns 14.

## Item 2: the `logic` control cannot catch what its docblock claims

The floor test's docblock says the `logic` union control guards against a reader that stops at the first line of a multi-line union. It cannot: `logic` is a **single-line** union (`[and, or]`), so a first-line-only reader reads it correctly and the control never fires for that mode.

⚠️ The mode **is** covered — by the zero-members throw plus the equality pin, which the reviewer measured RED 3/44 — so the guard exists; the **claim about which control provides it** is wrong. Correct the docblock (and the PR body if it repeats it) to name the mechanism that actually catches it.

## Item 3: two small wording corrections

- The pin says a **"LATER ruling"** where objectui#4814 in fact **predates** batch #88. Reword.
- "three new tests" is **two new plus one rewritten** — `it(` went 21 → 23.

## Scope

All three live in one test file plus the PR body of a merged PR. ⛔ Not a contract change; `Clause-②: no` on the face of it — but ⚠️ declare it from your own diff, and if fixing item 1 turns out to move what the pin accepts, that is the `yes` branch and the remedy is to **report and stop**.

⛔ Do not weaken or delete any of the pin's existing legs to make room. Its two-instrument ablation (the same doc-only mutation run against both the old and new pin) and its mirror-only leg are the reason this PR was believed; a fix that quietly drops one is worse than the bug.
